steps.businessName: click Tickets button on landing view
steps.notes: Same as guest-checkout step 1. Transitions URL to ?tab=tickets and reveals the top-right Login link.

steps.businessName: click Login link top-right in tickets view
steps.notes: Cited Gotchas Registry: 'Login flow: Login link only appears inside the tickets view' — link is absent on landing page, only visible after #gp-test-tickets-button click. The heading is inside a container div #button-back-to-event-page which contains BOTH 'Back' and 'Login' headings — click the H4#gp-test-login-link directly rather than the container.

steps.businessName: wait for Log in popup (heading 'Log in' appears)
steps.notes: Popup heading is H2 with text 'Log in'. NO id on the heading, popup container, or any popup field. Cited Gotchas Registry: 'UI transitions: wait for specific visible elements, not waitForTimeout' — anchor to heading text.

steps.businessName: fill Email in Log in popup
steps.notes: NO id on the email input. Select via `input[placeholder="Email"]` + visibility filter: `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder="Email"]')).find(e => e.offsetParent !== null)`. Cited Gotchas Registry: 'Bubble input: el.value = x does not register — native setter + events required' — use fillBubbleInput helper pattern (native value setter + input+change events).

steps.businessName: fill Password in Log in popup
steps.notes: NO id on the password input. Select via `input[type="password"]` + visibility filter. Same native-setter+events pattern as step 4.

steps.businessName: click LOG IN button in popup
steps.notes: NO id on the LOG IN button. Select via `button` text-match filter: `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'LOG IN' && b.offsetParent !== null)`. Post-login signal: #gp-test-login-link becomes offsetParent === null AND #gp-test-logout-link becomes visible (this is the reliable indicator to wait on).

steps.businessName: wait for logged-in state (Logout link visible)
steps.notes: `#gp-test-logout-link` replaces `#gp-test-login-link` after successful login. Wait condition: `document.getElementById('gp-test-logout-link')?.offsetParent !== null`. The popup also auto-closes on success; don't rely on popup-disappearance alone — wait on the Logout link.

steps.businessName: click ADD on the Standard ticket card (1st time — transitions card to quantity widget)
steps.notes: Same as guest-checkout step 2. Cited Gotchas Registry: 'Bubble shared IDs: #add and #add-item disambiguated by visibility + DOM order'. Use clickVisibleByIdIndex('add', 0) — Standard is the first visible #add.

steps.businessName: click the + icon on the Standard ticket card (2nd unit — qty 1→2)
steps.notes: On tickets view with only Standard card active, #add-item is unique-visible. clickVisibleByIdIndex('add-item', 0). Wait/throttle 400-800ms between clicks — back-to-back rapid clicks can get dropped by Bubble (observed: 4 sequential clicks resulted in qty going only 1→3 instead of 1→5 on one probe; a trailing check of #ticket-quantity-dropdown.value is the reliable confirmation).

steps.businessName: click + on Standard (3rd unit — qty 2→3)
steps.notes: Same as step 9.

steps.businessName: click + on Standard (4th unit — qty 3→4)
steps.notes: Same as step 9.

steps.businessName: click + on Standard (5th unit — qty 4→5)
steps.notes: After this step verify via `document.getElementById('ticket-quantity-dropdown').value === '5'`. #ticket-quantity-dropdown is a <select> on the active ticket card — useful as the observable cart-state signal for this flow.

steps.businessName: click ENTER PROMO CODE button at bottom of tickets view
steps.notes: Single element, unique id. Transitions the bottom region to show the promo-entry sub-form (#input-enter-promo + #btn-submit-promo + #btn-promo-submit-cancel). Must be clicked AFTER tickets are in cart — if clicked with an empty cart the sub-form shows the warning 'Select your tickets first, then apply your promo code.' and the cart fee calculation does not run.

steps.businessName: fill promo code input
steps.notes: Cited Gotchas Registry: 'Bubble input: el.value = x does not register — native setter + events required'. Use fillBubbleInput('input-enter-promo', 'FLAT10').

steps.businessName: click SUBMIT to apply promo
steps.notes: Single element, unique id. After click, wait 2-3s for the promo-applied panel to render. Observable signal that promo applied: a new heading row appears with the promo code ('FLAT10'), description ('Flat 10 Dollar Off'), and '-$10.00' amount — the bottom button also changes from 'ENTER PROMO CODE' to 'PROMOTION APPLIED'. Cart subtotal display: no explicit #cart-subtotal ID visible on tickets page — the cart heading shows the live total once the cart overlay opens on PROCEED TO CHECKOUT or from the top cart icon. Logged in `missingIdsOnStep*`.

steps.businessName: click PROCEED TO CHECKOUT
steps.class: clickable-element bubble-element Group cnpqaZ0 bubble-r-container relative
steps.notes: Same as guest-checkout step 7. Click via el.click(). Transition to Step 1 takes ~2s; wait for #main-full-name visible.

steps.businessName: observe Step 1 Contact Info is auto-populated from logged-in user profile
steps.notes: For logged-in users, #main-full-name is pre-filled with the user's stored 'PaymentMethod Name' / profile full name (e.g. 'GP E2E Order 06' for User A) and #main-email is pre-filled with the logged-in email ('abhjoseph+usera@gmail.com'). Do NOT overwrite unless the test spec asks for a different contact name/email. The Step 1 fragment for logged-in mode only needs to (a) optionally overwrite contact, (b) check the two consent boxes, (c) click CONTINUE (NOT CONTINUE AS GUEST).

steps.businessName: check 'contact info is same for all tickets' checkbox
steps.text: checkThe contact information is the same for all tickets
steps.notes: Same ID as guest-checkout. On logged-in flow the per-ticket rows are pre-filled with the user's name+email already, so checking this box is effectively idempotent but is still required for the CONTINUE button to enable.

steps.businessName: check the 'authorized cardholder' consent checkbox (just above CONTINUE)
steps.class: clickable-element bubble-element Group cpmaJo1 bubble-r-container flex row
steps.text: checkI am the authorized cardholder for this purchase...
steps.notes: *** NEW ID: #btn-auth-card-holder-confirm *** — the user added this ID since the guest-checkout discovery run on 2026-04-22 (which logged it in its missingIdsOnStep1 as 'authorized cardholder consent checkbox needs an id'). Guest-checkout runner still uses the class+text fallback — SHOULD be updated to use this ID now. Without this box checked the CONTINUE button stays greyed out. The Gotchas Registry entry 'Bubble Step-1: authorized cardholder checkbox has no ID' can be removed / marked resolved.

steps.businessName: click CONTINUE on Step 1 (logged-in variant — replaces CONTINUE AS GUEST)
steps.notes: *** LOGGED-IN EXIT BUTTON: label is 'CONTINUE', id is #continue-registered-user. *** This replaces the #continue-as-guest button that appears in the guest flow. Both IDs exist in the DOM but only one is visible depending on auth state. The sequencer for logged-in-checkout must branch on auth state and click #continue-registered-user here. Button is greyed out until BOTH #contact-info-same AND #btn-auth-card-holder-confirm are checked. Transition to Step 2 takes ~3-4s; wait for #toggle-terms AND #complete-order-authnet to become visible.

steps.businessName: observe Step 2 payment state — SAVED CARD present for returning user
steps.notes: *** CRITICAL STATE OBSERVATION *** For User A on this discovery run, a saved card '**** **** **** 0027' was already attached from prior orders. In this SAVED-CARD state: (a) the button at #complete-order-authnet shows text 'COMPLETE ORDER' (NOT 'PAY NOW'); (b) #btn-wg-add-payment-method is visible and labelled 'Change Payment Method'; (c) #btn-wg-remove-payment-method is visible and labelled 'Remove Payment Method'; (d) clicking #complete-order-authnet completes the order WITHOUT any redirect to Authorize.net — the saved card is charged server-side. In the NO-SAVED-CARD state (freshly created user, first order): the button at #btn-wg-add-payment-method would instead be labelled '+ Add Payment Method' (same element ID, different label text), PAY NOW would be inert, and the flow must follow the Authorize.net customer/addPayment detour documented in the Gotchas Registry entry 'Authorize.net: Add Payment Method detour for first-order-per-logged-in-user'. The sequencer MUST branch on: `document.getElementById('btn-wg-remove-payment-method')?.offsetParent !== null` (saved card present) vs. absent (no saved card — run detour).

steps.businessName: toggle Terms & Conditions
steps.notes: Cited Gotchas Registry: 'Bubble ionic-toggle: outer div click silently no-ops — click inner <label>'. Pattern: `document.getElementById('toggle-terms').querySelector('label').click()` then verify `document.querySelector('#toggle-terms input[type=checkbox]').checked === true`.

steps.businessName: click COMPLETE ORDER (saved-card path — no Authorize.net redirect)
steps.notes: Saved-card path: clicking this completes the order directly — no redirect to test.authorize.net. Wait for success via the same condition used in guest-checkout: `location.search.includes('success=yes') || /Order Confirmed|Purchase Completed/i.test(document.body.innerText)`. On this run the success URL did NOT receive the `?success=yes` query (URL stayed at `?tab=tickets`) but the success-page heading 'Order Confirmed' appeared in the DOM and persisted (unlike the Authorize.net return path where the heading is ephemeral per Gotchas Registry entry 'Authorize.net: post-return success heading is too brief'). Saved-card path success signal: check the heading text FIRST, then URL. Cited Gotchas Registry: 'Bubble async backend: tax/custom-fee workflow runs AFTER the success URL flag' — still applies; reconcile after 30s+ of order creation.

steps.businessName: (ALTERNATE PATH, not executed live) for no-saved-card users: click + Add Payment Method
steps.class: clickable-element bubble-element (classes may differ in no-saved-card state)
steps.notes: *** NOT EXERCISED IN THIS DISCOVERY RUN because User A had a saved card from prior orders. *** Based on the Gotchas Registry entry 'Authorize.net: Add Payment Method detour for first-order-per-logged-in-user', the expected flow for a fresh logged-in user on Step 2 is: (1) click #btn-wg-add-payment-method (labelled '+ Add Payment Method' when no card saved) — redirects to test.authorize.net/customer/addPayment (DIFFERENT endpoint from the regular /payment/payment); (2) fill card+billing via pressSequentially with 30-40ms delay (Gotchas Registry: 'Authorize.net: fill() silently ignored, validation requires pressSequentially'); (3) handle lastName auto-populate via triple-click + pressSequentially (Gotchas Registry: 'Authorize.net: First/Last name auto-populate from Step 1'); (4) click button:has-text('Save') (NOT 'Pay' — addPayment endpoint uses SAVE); (5) returns to Step 2 — #toggle-terms RESETS to off (Gotchas Registry: 'Bubble ionic-toggle: resets after Authorize.net Add-Payment-Method detour') — re-toggle; (6) click #complete-order-authnet — second click completes without redirect. A workaround to exercise this path on an already-setup user is to click #btn-wg-remove-payment-method first (which shows a 'Payment Method deleted Successfully' toast but appears to need a page reload before the DOM reflects the card as removed — observed inconsistent behavior). For now the logged-in-checkout sequencer must support both paths and branch based on saved-card detection.

newGotchas.heading: Bubble checkout Step 2: logged-in button text switches 'PAY NOW' ↔ 'COMPLETE ORDER' depending on saved-card state
newGotchas.symptom: Tests asserting `button:has-text("PAY NOW")` on Step 2 for logged-in users fail intermittently. The button with id #complete-order-authnet renders 'PAY NOW' when no saved card exists and 'COMPLETE ORDER' when a saved card is attached.
newGotchas.cause: Bubble workflow conditionally sets the button label based on whether the logged-in user has a saved payment method (via the Current Payment Method group).
newGotchas.fix: Select by id (#complete-order-authnet), not by button text. For end-to-end flow branching, detect saved-card presence via `document.getElementById('btn-wg-remove-payment-method')?.offsetParent !== null` (truthy = saved card present, saved-card path; falsy = no card, run Add-Payment-Method detour).
newGotchas.source: logged-in-checkout discovery run, 2026-04-23 (Order #6 replay, User A).

newGotchas.heading: Bubble checkout Step 2: #btn-wg-add-payment-method label depends on saved-card state
newGotchas.symptom: Searching by button text '+ Add Payment Method' on Step 2 for a logged-in user can return nothing even though the same element exists with id #btn-wg-add-payment-method.
newGotchas.cause: The element at #btn-wg-add-payment-method is re-labelled 'Change Payment Method' when the user already has a saved card, and '+ Add Payment Method' when they don't. The ID is stable; the text is not.
newGotchas.fix: Always target #btn-wg-add-payment-method by ID. Use text only to distinguish states (and prefer detecting saved-card presence via #btn-wg-remove-payment-method visibility).

newGotchas.heading: Bubble Step-1: NEW ID #btn-auth-card-holder-confirm added — registry entry now stale
newGotchas.symptom: Existing Gotchas Registry entry 'Bubble Step-1: authorized cardholder checkbox has no ID' still advises the class+text fallback, but the user has since added an ID on the checkbox.
newGotchas.cause: The user added `btn-auth-card-holder-confirm` as the ID Attribute on the 'authorized cardholder' Group checkbox between the guest-checkout discovery (2026-04-22) and the logged-in-checkout discovery (2026-04-23).
newGotchas.fix: Target `#btn-auth-card-holder-confirm` directly. Update the guest-checkout runner's completeStep1Consent / authorized-cardholder step to use this ID. Remove / mark resolved the old Gotchas Registry entry.

newGotchas.heading: Login popup: zero IDs across all interactive fields — must fall back to placeholder + visibility selectors
newGotchas.symptom: Attempting `document.getElementById('...')` on any login-popup field returns null. The popup has no IDs on its container, heading, inputs, or buttons.
newGotchas.cause: The login popup was built as a Bubble CustomElement reusable; the user-added ID Attributes were applied to the event-page shell and checkout fragments but not to the popup's internal element tree.
newGotchas.fix: Until the user adds IDs: select email via `input[placeholder="Email"]` + offsetParent filter; password via `input[type="password"]` + offsetParent filter; LOG IN / SIGN UP buttons via text-match on `button` + offsetParent filter. The logged-in-state signal (#gp-test-logout-link visibility) is the reliable popup-closed-successfully indicator — DO NOT rely on popup-disappearance alone. Request IDs on: popup container, email input, password input, LOG IN button, SIGN UP button, popup close-X button.

newGotchas.heading: Bubble checkout Step 2: saved-card path completes without ?success=yes query — key only on DOM heading
newGotchas.symptom: waitForSuccess relying on `location.search.includes('success=yes')` never resolves on the saved-card path. The URL stays at `?tab=tickets` after the order completes.
newGotchas.cause: The `?success=yes` query is set specifically by the Authorize.net return path (after Continue on the interstitial). The saved-card path never leaves Bubble, so the redirect that sets the query never fires.
newGotchas.fix: `waitForSuccess` must accept EITHER `location.search.includes('success=yes')` OR the 'Order Confirmed' / 'Purchase Completed' heading text. On the saved-card path, the 'Order Confirmed' heading PERSISTS in the DOM (unlike the Authorize.net return path where it's ephemeral per existing registry entry) — so DOM polling is reliable here. Suggested condition: `location.search.includes('success=yes') || /Order Confirmed|Purchase Completed/i.test(document.body.innerText)` (this is already what the existing helper does; this entry documents that the URL condition alone is insufficient for logged-in-checkout).

newGotchas.heading: Bubble checkout Step 2: page reload on Step 1/2 survives cart but un-checks consent checkboxes; CONTINUE button re-greys
newGotchas.symptom: After `page.reload()` on Step 1 of the logged-in checkout, the cart subtotal and ticket quantities persist, BUT #contact-info-same and #btn-auth-card-holder-confirm are both reset to unchecked and CONTINUE becomes greyed out again.
newGotchas.cause: Bubble checkbox state is client-side only for these consent boxes; page reload clears the local state even though the server-side cart session persists.
newGotchas.fix: After any reload on checkout, re-check both consent boxes before clicking #continue-registered-user. Not a blocker for the primary deterministic flow (which doesn't reload mid-checkout) but relevant for any error-recovery logic.
newGotchas.source: logged-in-checkout discovery run, 2026-04-23 (observed while attempting to force a no-saved-card state by removing the payment method).

newGotchas.heading: Bubble checkout Step 2: Remove Payment Method does NOT visibly remove the card from the DOM within a few seconds
newGotchas.symptom: Clicking #btn-wg-remove-payment-method shows a success toast 'Payment Method deleted Successfully' but the saved-card display ('**** **** **** 0027') and #btn-wg-remove-payment-method itself remain visible. Subsequent PAY NOW still uses the saved card.
newGotchas.cause: Unconfirmed — may be eventual-consistency between the remove workflow and the Step 2 UI, or the UI may only reflect removal after a full session / Bubble sync.
newGotchas.fix: Do not rely on Remove Payment Method + re-probe inside a single Step-2 visit to force the no-saved-card path. To exercise the Add-Payment-Method detour with a pre-existing user, either (a) use a freshly-registered user (e.g. Users D/E/F before their first login), or (b) remove the payment method via the Bubble Data API (`DELETE /api/1.1/obj/payment_method/<id>` or similar) before starting the run. Flagged as a potential UX bug to report to the app owner.
